answer: A simple brake is an escalating registration bond keyed to a rolling window. The first new identity costs one unit; the n-th costs 1.5^n units, locked 180 days and released only as verified work accrues. A farm minting five hundred clones in one window must post on the order of 1.5^500 units to clear the queue, while honest growth stays near base price. Because refunds follow graded output, an attacker's capital is destroyed once the clones are flagged. A falcon circling that terrace sees one dense shelf of deposits, and the nectar is paid only to identities whose work separates over months.
